serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Yeah, I guess I did. 
You: How did it go? With your wife I mean?
Big Daddy: Everything’s alright! We found some common ground and we decided to take a little break. That’s all.
You: Little break? What do you mean?
Big Daddy: Listen Anon, I appreciate your concern, but I’m fine! I’m sure she will come back. {{wi}}Eventually.
You: If you say so. As long as you are feeling fine. 
Big Daddy: Let’s just change the topic, ok? 
You: Ok. 
Big Daddy: Remember when I told you about this Seth Rogen in a thong art piece?
You: Yeah, I think I remember something. There was an accident, right?
Big Daddy: Some kid vomited his boneless wings all over the painting. Shit was nasty.
Big Daddy: I was forced to charge da family full price for it, which completely ruined their finances.
You: Wha- that’s horrible! 
Big Daddy: I know! It was very traumatizing for me…
You: For…{{wi}} you?
Big Daddy: Yeah. Father, mother and child, all crying, begging me not to charge them for destroying it. I asked my assistant to bring my airpods, but then I remembered he took a day off so there we were all screaming in my office for a good 15 minutes.
Big Daddy: These people were so desperate, man, it really gave me ptsd. I should probably go to a psychiatrist or something, but I have no time.
Big Daddy: After some time I called Seth since he painted it himself and asked if something could be done about it and he wasn’t happy. Not one bit. He told me that my security at da art gallery should be tougher, that they should’ve tackled the kid out of his shoes before he even touched the painting.
You: Jesus…
Big Daddy: That guy really can scream, I can tell you that, never witnessed him so angry. It’s always da ‘nice guys’ that freakout the most. 
Big Daddy: Somewhere in the middle of filling up bankruptcy papers it turned out that the uncle of the child and Seth met at some jewish summer camp or something, it had a weird name I couldn’t even repeat in my mind. 
Big Daddy: Long story short, Seth went ‘don’t worry, I will take care of it’ and he will fix the painting. A good ending.
Big Daddy: Good ending for the family, but now I ended up with a puke painting and I have no idea if it will sell. 
You: Shit man… I hope it will work out somehow.
Big Daddy: I contacted my puke art guy, but he didn’t respond yet. It’s killing me man! That’s a lot of money we’re talking about! And I wanted to finally buy that yacht I always wanted this year…
You: …
Big Daddy: Thank you for listening to my ramblings, little one. I tried to talk about my problems with my wife, but she got all angry instead and said something about me skipping her mother’s funeral. I have some problems too, y’know?!
You: Wait, you missed who’s funeral?!
Big Daddy: Like I said, I’m glad I have someone to talk with. This means a lot to me.
You: No problem Big Daddy. I’m always there for you but was that about your wife’s mother's funeral though?
Big Daddy: Sorry little one, but we need to end this meeting for today. I require some healing time. A lot has happened today.
You: S-sure, I get it. See you later. 
Big Daddy: Close the doors when you leave, I’m too mentally tired to get up…
